title: How does tone of voice change what your words mean?
examples: Why do people think I am rude when I am not?
How can the same words mean different things?

explain.say: Here is a fun test: say, thanks a lot, in a happy voice. Now say it in a cross voice. Same words, different meaning! Look at the board. The needle points to warm: soft and smiley.

explain.say: Tone of voice means how your voice sounds: loud or soft, fast or slow, high or low. See the flat zone? Low and slow can sound tired or bored. And the shaky zone sounds worried. Can you hear the difference?

zones.label: Sharp
zones.ask: Why do people think I am angry when I am not?

explain.say: Now look at the sharp zone. Loud and hard, THANKS a lot, can sound angry, even if you did not mean it. People often believe your tone more than your words. Have you ever been misunderstood?

explain.say: Watch Nadia. She shows Omar her camel drawing, and he says, nice, in a sharp, bored voice. See her sad face? The word nice did not sound nice at all.

explain.say: Then Omar tries again, warmly: nice, I love the hump! Look how happy Nadia is. Brilliant! Wow fact: in Mandarin Chinese, tone changes the word itself, so ma can mean mother or horse.

faq.a: Tone of voice is how your voice sounds when you speak: loud or soft, fast or slow, warm or sharp. It tells people how you feel about what you are saying.

faq.q: Why do people think I am angry when I am not?
faq.a: Your voice might sound loud, fast or sharp when you are excited or tired. Try slowing down, speaking softer and smiling as you talk.
asks: Why do people say I sound rude?

faq.a: Sarcasm is saying the opposite of what you mean in a special tone, like saying great when something bad happens. It can be funny between friends but can also hurt.
asks: Why do people say the opposite of what they mean?

faq.q: How can I make my voice sound kinder?
faq.a: Slow down, speak a little softer, smile while you talk, and take a breath first if you feel cross.
asks: Tell me about the Smile as you talk

faq.q: Does tone matter in text messages?
faq.a: Yes, and it is harder to tell. Short replies like k can seem cross. Adding a few friendly words helps people read your message the way you mean it.
asks: Why do my messages sound rude?

facts: Mandarin Chinese is a tonal language: the syllable ma with a high level tone means mother, and with a dipping tone it means horse.
Studies show people often trust the tone of voice more than the words when the two do not match.

quiz.say: Omar says "Nice." in a sharp, bored voice. How might Nadia feel?

options.show: Hurt, because it does not sound kind
options.say: Hurt, because it does not sound kind

quiz.why: A sharp, bored tone makes even kind words sound unkind.

wrong.0: The tone did not sound like real praise.

quiz.say: Which helps your voice sound kinder?
quiz.why: A slower, softer voice sounds calm and kind.

wrong.0: Fast and loud can sound cross.
wrong.2: Sighing can sound bored or annoyed.
